skill.summary: Create Google Docs from Markdown files. Use when the user wants to create a Google Doc from Markdown content, or when working with gog CLI and need to populate Google Docs with content. This skill handles the conversion Markdown → DOCX → Google Docs via Drive upload, since gog docs CLI only supports create/export/cat/copy but NOT write/update content.
